name: AvengeKidmon
main_effect:
When you would play this card from your hand, reduce its memory cost by 1 for each Option card in you and your opponent's trashes.
[On Play] Return all cards with the [Three Musketeers] trait and all Option cards from both players' trashes to the bottom of their owners' decks. If 7 or more cards were returned using this effect, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the [Three Musketeers] trait or 8000 DP or less.
